artists.name: Sam Rajput
artists.full_bio:
Sam Rajput is a singer and trained vocalist from Agra, India, known for his versatile vocal ability and emotive approach to music. With a strong foundation in vocal training, Sam has developed a sound that blends contemporary Indian pop with influences from multiple musical genres.

A professionally trained musician, Sam studied at KMMC – A.R. Rahman’s Music College, where he further developed his understanding of music and vocal performance.

Sam gained recognition with his song “Naam Tumhara,” released in 2020, which became one of the defining tracks of his early career. Since then, he has continued to explore different sounds and styles through releases including Tere Na Hue To, Tere Sang, Ro Hi Padi, Aise Kyun, and Barsaat.

With his trained vocals, wide-ranging musicality, and ability to adapt across genres, Sam Rajput continues to build his identity as a contemporary Indian vocalist while bringing his own emotional character to every song.

releases.title: Chela
releases.description:
“Chela” by Slay is a hard-hitting hip-hop track produced by Otis, built around sharp flows, relentless energy, and back-to-back bars. Slay comes through with an aggressive delivery, switching flows and keeping the momentum moving from start to finish.

With its heavy production and bar-focused approach, “Chela” is a straight-up rap record made for listeners who appreciate raw energy, punchlines, and unapologetic hip-hop.

releases.title: Namaskar
releases.description: Artisttaan presents “Namaskar” – Hindi Rap Song by SLAY. “Namaskar” is a hard-hitting Hindi rap / Desi hip-hop track by SLAY, showcasing raw energy, confidence, and underground vibes. Produced by HMNXSU, the song represents real hustle and the new wave of Indian hip-hop culture. With powerful visuals directed by Shashank Sharma, “Namaskar” delivers attitude, bars, and authenticity.

releases.description:
Smack” is a hard-hitting track from Tarun Bist’s album Garh Kumaon, featuring Slay. Bringing together two distinct voices from Uttarakhand’s hip-hop scene, the track blends raw energy, sharp lyricism, and a grounded Pahadi identity.
Written by Tarun Bist and Slay, “Smack” captures their unapologetic approach to hip-hop, combining powerful verses with a distinctive sound that reflects the attitude and culture behind Garh Kumaon.
